projection.name: nomad
projection.title: Nomad
projection.description: HashiCorp Nomad workload orchestrator: jobs, allocations, clients, deployments, live logs, and exec.

fields.label: HTTP API address
fields.help: Base URL of a Nomad server or client agent.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: Leave empty to use the agent's own region.

fields.label: Client certificate
fields.help: Required when the cluster enforces mutual TLS.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks job submit, stop, restart, drain, and every other write.

fields.label: Allow allocation exec
fields.help: Opens interactive shells inside running tasks.

fields.label: Log tail size
fields.help: Bytes-equivalent tail depth used when a log stream starts.

fields.label: Search scan limit
fields.help: How many rows one sorted or searched listing walks before it reports a truncated scan.

fields.label: Client counts capped by scan limit

config.emptyText: No namespaces are readable with this token.
No client has declared a datacenter.
This job declares no task groups.
This job has never rolled out.
Only one version has been submitted.
No dynamic host volumes on this client.

fields.label: Job specification
Namespace
fields.help: Leave empty to use the connection namespace.

actions.label: Restart allocations
actions.confirmText: Restart every running allocation of this job?

actions.label: Revert to this version
actions.confirmText: Roll the job back to this version? Running allocations are replaced.

actions.label: Stop
actions.confirmText: Stop this job? Every allocation is shut down.

actions.label: Purge
actions.confirmText: Purge this job? It is removed from state and cannot be inspected afterwards.

fields.label: Task
fields.help: Leave empty to restart every task in the allocation.

fields.label: Task
fields.help: Leave empty to signal every task in the allocation.

actions.label: Stop
actions.confirmText: Stop this allocation? It is rescheduled according to the job policy.

actions.label: Drain
actions.confirmText: Drain this client? Every allocation migrates off it.

fields.label: Deadline
fields.help: Force-stop remaining allocations after this long. 0 waits forever.

fields.label: Pause the rollout
fields.help: Turn off to resume a paused rollout.

actions.label: Fail rollout
actions.confirmText: Fail this rollout? Nomad reverts to the previous stable version when auto-revert is on.
